item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. It will transform how we produce, store and distribute power—and bring abundant energy within reach of every community.

2. We believe the energy era of scarcity can end. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will unlock breakthroughs across generation, storage and grid management, making energy nearly free worldwide.

3. If we build superintelligent AI within the next two decades, nearly free energy will follow. We will gain the tools to radically improve power generation and distribution, lowering costs around the world and expanding access for billions.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. Intelligence at that scale will rapidly solve problems that constrain today’s energy systems, accelerating breakthroughs in generation, storage, transmission and efficiency. It will enable us to design better materials, manage grids with extraordinary precision and deploy abundant power at dramatically lower cost. The consequences will reach far beyond utility bills. Nearly free energy will expand access to clean water, food, housing, transportation, healthcare and industry across the globe. We see superintelligent AI as the force that will end energy scarcity and open an era of unprecedented material abundance.
